market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.2m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Per OPEC MOMR (secondary), Venezuela produced ~988 tb/d in March 2026, having risen from ~900 tb/d earlier. April export reports show 1.23m bpd (highest since 2018) supported by US sanctions waivers and Chevron asset swaps; production is expected to track close to exports given inventory dynamics. Reaching 1,200 tb/d in any month with 8 months left and an established uptrend is roughly even — possible base case but not assured given political volatility and OPEC reporting lags.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether OPEC's secondary-sources figure formally crosses 1,200 tb/d (vs. exports), and political/sanctions reversals over remaining months.
